spans.s: राग m. 1. Dying, colour, hue; 2. red colour, रागेण बालारुणकोमलेन चूतप्रवालोष्ठमलंचकार K.S.iii.30; 3. an affection, passion, feeling, चित्तं मुनेरपि हरन्ति निवृत्तरागम् Rt.ii.25; 4. musical harmony, a musical mode; (six primary Rāgas are enumerated, भैरवः कोशिकश्चैव हिंदोलो दीपकस्तथा । श्रीरागो मेघरागश्च रागाः षडिति कीर्तिताः; from these are derived innumerable modes mixed and simple), अहो रागपारवाहिणी गीतिः Sak.v., K.S.vii.91; 5. sympathy, pleasure, पुरा चक्षूरागस्तदनु मनसोऽनन्यपरता M.M.vi.; 6. anger, wrath; 7. regret, sorrow; 8. greediness, envy; 9. beauty, charm.
राग-चूर्ण m. 1. the Khadira tree; 2. red lead; 3. a red powder thrown by people on one another at the Holī festival; 4. the god of love.
राग-द्रव्य n. a paint, a dye.
राग-बन्ध m. the expression of Rāgas in due order, the manifestation of musical harmony, भावो भावं नुंदति विषयाद्रागबन्धः स एव Mal.ii.
राग-सूत्र n. 1. any coloured thread, a silk-thread; 2. the string of a balance.
रागिन् (I) a. (f. णी) 1. Coloured, dyed; 2. red; 3. full of feeling, impassioned, affectionate; 4. devotedly attached to, delighted in, desirous of.
रागिन् (II) m. 1. A painter; 2. a lover, a libertine.
रागिन् (I) a. (f. णी) 1. Coloured, dyed; 2. red; 3. full of feeling, impassioned, affectionate; 4. devotedly attached to, delighted in, desirous of.
रागिणी f. 1. A modification of a musical mode of which thirty or thirty-six are enumerated; 2. a wanton and intriguing woman.
